title: Bull elk ramming cars in Mammoth Hot Springs

contents: Raw b-roll, no audio. A rutting bull elk in Mammoth Hot Springs rams a white truck while tourists film (0–27 s), walks across lawns and road and swipes a maroon sedan (27–47 s), then repeatedly gores a row of parked cars (47–61 s).
